annotations.title: Get a country or town guide

description: The Meridian Dispatch guide to a country or a town: why go, how long to stay, when to go, getting there and around, practical FAQ answers, a structured fact sheet where one exists (nights, months, travel times, areas to stay, ranked top things, day trips, watch-outs), the places worth your time (with their own guide links), the hotels it recommends, and the related dispatches.

country.description: The country, to tell apart towns that share a name (Granada, Valencia, Mérida).

name.description: A country or town name, e.g. "Slovenia" or "Bled".
